name: Kaito
source:
Likes: All kinds of food
Dislikes: Height
Hobby: Swimming
Home: Summer Village

A genius fire-wielding ninja who surpasses his ancestor

Kaito is the only son of the Summer Village chieftain. His ancestor is Enya from the Fire Village. He has an innate ability of wielding fire, and is regarded as a second Enya by the villagers. However, as a genius ninja, he is not happy to be "playing second."
He feels a strong sense of rivalry with the big cities, Spring Village and Fall Village, where villagers look down on his village as "the countryside;" however, their ninja skills are actually on an equal footing.

He doesn't get along with Kikyo.

[From in-game profile (Season 1)]
